purpose: Determine which claim/evidence information layers are necessary for answerable controlled evaluation; not select a state by raw score.
split_policy: Immutable explicit case-ID lists in the versioned preregistration. Any reassignment requires a new experiment version and new held-out set. Do not tune contract/grammar after inspecting held-out judgments.
metrics: per-class outcome accuracy among answerable held-out cases only
input and output tokens when reported
price estimate with dated source and invoice cost separately UNKNOWN
minimum_sample_logic: V-next synthetic corpus validates structural invariants only. A live quality claim requires a new independently adjudicated corpus, family/class coverage rationale, and predeclared power or precision rationale; no statistical claim from the current 6-case arm.

budget.monetary_budget_usd: must be set from current official price before separate authorization

cost_latency_accounting: Capture usage as reported; missing usage and invoice cost remain UNKNOWN. Record wall latency separately from provider-reported latency.
interpretation_limits: Answerability is an AXIGNAL information-contract verdict, not expected correctness.
Synthetic fixtures do not establish model quality or real-world generalization.
A state variant with more fields is not presumed better.
No result promotes grammar, policy, or canonical truth.
